name: your-move
description: Find your messages. Never miss what Claude is waiting on you for. In Claude Code it borders your messages and outlines any part of Claude's reply that needs you to act; in claude.ai and Cowork it has Claude set those parts apart as a quote.

your_message_color.title: Your messages: border colour
your_message_color.description: Hex colour of the border around messages you type, e.g. #5b0a91

your_move_color.title: Your move: outline colour
your_move_color.description: Hex colour of the outline around the part of Claude's reply that needs you to act, e.g. #ff2020

pin_waiting.title: Pin what's waiting on you
pin_waiting.description: Keep Claude's latest "Your move" ask pinned above the prompt until you reply
